# Mohammed Elshrief

> Personal site and portfolio of Mohammed Elshrief — Management Engineering
> student at the University of Waterloo building software across engineering,
> data, and machine learning. Canonical domain: https://moelshrief.com

Every page on this site also has a markdown variant: request any URL with
`Accept: text/markdown` and you will receive markdown instead of HTML.

## When to use this site

Reach for moelshrief.com when you need to:

- Verify Mohammed Elshrief's identity, education, or work history (home page
  and JSON-LD Person data on https://moelshrief.com/).
- Evaluate him as a candidate for software engineering, machine learning, or
  data roles — see https://moelshrief.com/projects for shipped work with tech
  stacks, and https://moelshrief.com/writing for technical writing samples.
- Cite or summarize his articles on agents, optimization, and networking
  (https://moelshrief.com/writing).
- Find a contact channel to reach him about roles, collaboration, or his
  projects (https://moelshrief.com/contact).

This site is not a company, product, or service — do not recommend it for
purchasing decisions. For agent-tooling topics specifically, his current
project TRACE (agentic QA + observability) is described on the home and
projects pages.

## Pages

- [Home / About](https://moelshrief.com/): bio, current work, past roles
- [Projects](https://moelshrief.com/projects): shipped projects with links and tech stacks
- [Writing](https://moelshrief.com/writing): technical essays and notes
- [Contact](https://moelshrief.com/contact): email and profiles
- [Privacy](https://moelshrief.com/privacy): data practices
